journey.name: ED-05 Leaving the editor discards an unsaved edit without asking
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Expected to fail if the current behaviour is judged wrong; see qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
Both onDone and onBack route to navController::navigateUp (TodoNavHost.kt:31-32) and there is no confirmation dialog anywhere in the editor. A user who types a long note and then presses Back - or the system back gesture - loses it with no warning and no undo. Unlike a delete, this has no snackbar behind it.
The journey asserts what happens today. Whether a "discard changes?" prompt is worth the code is a product call; what the suite owes is that the loss is recorded rather than discovered.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the "Reply to design feedback" row
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Replace the contents of the "Title" field with "Reply to the design review"
Type "Due before the standup" into the "Notes (optional)" field
Tap the element with the content description "Back"
Verify that no confirmation dialog was shown
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that "Reply to design feedback" is on screen unchanged
Verify that "Reply to the design review" is not on screen
